ai_generated_tags.description: This living room exemplifies a contemporary Indian design, blending traditional elements with modern aesthetics. The space features a rich brown sofa with tufted cushions, adorned with a decorative pillow, set against a backdrop of marble flooring and wooden ceiling beams. The room is enhanced by tree-patterned curtains and a carved wooden door with brass inlays, reflecting South Indian architectural influences. Contemporary touches include sleek wall-mounted lights and a polished metal peacock decoration, which adds a touch of elegance and cultural significance.
